cells.additional_notes: Single-junction Sn–Pb perovskite solar cell reported PCE = 22.1% and operational time up to 1,830 hours. Reported absorber improvements: dark carrier density ~1.3 × 10^14 cm–3; bulk carrier lifetime ~9.2 μs; surface recombination velocity ~1.4 cm s–1. Quasi-2D (PEA)2GAPb2I7 forms on top of the 3D Sn–Pb perovskite via PEA+ and GA+ additives and acts as a barrier to Sn diffusion and passivates defects.

layers.name: 3D Sn–Pb perovskite
